title: The multi-agent scenarios' inputs are frozen and each run prints its plan and cost estimate with no model call
goal: kb/_self/reports/multi_bench.csv holds one row per agent and input with the columns scenario, agent, role and input: lookups has 4 lookup agents of 5 questions each over 10 distinct pool or eval row ids, research has 3 research agents on one repro_briefs area, mixed has 2 research agents, 2 code agents whose input names a planted item spec (title, goal, touches, check and one gate with a recommendation, written as a sandbox backlog item at setup) plus 1 lookup agent; multi inputs [--file FILE] exits 1 naming each row whose question id, area or item spec does not resolve; multi run SCENARIO --dry-run prints each agent's role, model, argv and knob values (--sequential, --coord, --stagger, --model with a model per role, --pack-budget, --tools kb|files, --manager code|session) with an estimate in USD from bench_core.PRICE and the recorded rows' means, creates nothing and starts no model

roles = collections.Counter(r["role"] for r in {r["agent"]: r for r in by["mixed"]}.values())
assert roles == collections.Counter(research=2, code=2, lookup=1), roles

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.mkdir(B)
MARK = os.path.join(T, "claude-was-started")
open(os.path.join(B, "claude"), "w").write("#!/bin/sh\necho started >> " + MARK + "\nexit 1\n")
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, "claude"), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"])
def bench(*a, ok=(0,), timeout=1200):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=timeout)
    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-600:], r.stderr[-600:])
    return r

d = os.path.join(T, "none")
knobs = ["--coord", "isolated", "--stagger", "30", "--model", "lookup=haiku-5-5,research=haiku-5-5,code=sonnet-5-5",
         "--pack-budget", "600", "--tools", "files", "--manager", "session"]
for s in ("lookups", "research", "mixed"):
    for extra in ([], ["--sequential"], knobs):
        r = bench("multi", "run", s, "--dir", d, "--dry-run", *extra)
        assert "estimate" in r.stdout and "$" in r.stdout, (s, extra, r.stdout[-600:])
assert not os.path.exists(d), "--dry-run created the sandbox"
assert not os.path.exists(MARK), "a dry run started claude"
